fields.description: Rosehill is an apartment development on the golf-course side of Dubai Hills Estate. One, two and three bedroom homes are paired with landscaped courtyards, pools and sports spaces. Balconies and terraces vary considerably between blocks and floors, so the specific layout matters as much as the bedroom count.
amenities: Outdoor wet and dry play areas

overview: Rosehill’s brochure treats outdoor space as part of the residential experience: planted courtyards, places to sit, a pool deck and areas for children to play. Its mix of padel, half basketball, table tennis and outdoor fitness gives the scheme a more active side too. Golf-course views are advertised for selected terraces; they should be checked against the chosen block, floor and orientation rather than assumed across every home.
research.locationNote: The official location map shows Dubai Hills Golf Course, Dubai Hills Mall, Dubai Hills Park, GEMS International School and King’s College Hospital within the surrounding community. Al Khail Road and Umm Suqeim Street provide the wider road context. Distances and actual journey times vary by route and traffic.
research.priceNote: Emaar’s live page displays units from AED 1,756,888, alongside older starting-price wording of AED 1.6 million. The current published entry figure is shown here; a unit-specific quotation and availability check are still required.
research.paymentNote: The launch plan totals 80% before completion and 20% on estimated completion. Several early dates have passed, so this schedule is historical context rather than a new booking offer. Check the outstanding balance and applicable milestones for the selected unit.
research.handoverNote: The branded payment sheet gives June 2029 as estimated construction completion; Property Finder reports the same month. Current construction status and the contractual handover terms need confirmation.

facts.label: Launch collection and pricing
facts.value: The launch sheet lists 353 homes: 197 one bedroom, 118 two bedroom and 38 three bedroom apartments, with entry prices of AED 1.6m, AED 2.31m and AED 3.56m respectively. These are dated launch figures, not remaining stock or current offers.

facts.label: Different count scopes
facts.value: Mitchell’s October 2026 registry report describes 555 homes across Blocks A, B and C, compared with 353 in the launch sheet. The difference needs developer clarification; neither figure is presented as current availability.

facts.label: Balcony versus internal area
facts.value: All table totals include balcony space. For example, Block A Type 1E unit G03 has a 1,491.99 sq ft suite and 579.85 sq ft balcony, totalling 2,071.84 sq ft. Its plan includes a maid’s room and separate laundry.

facts.label: Document scope
facts.value: The official floor-plan download reviewed is Block B. The separately linked Block A pack has different layouts and size limits. The launch fact-sheet ranges closely match B, so they should not be used as limits for A.

unresolved: Block C floor plans and unit-specific dimensions were not available in the reviewed downloads; no range has been inferred from A or B.
